steps.what: Read researchers' problem descriptions and locate relevant computational methods and prior analyses
Consult with researchers to analyze problems and determine suitable computational strategies
Write the technology-based recommendations and computational strategy in the existing project decision note
Save the researchers' computational strategy note in the shared project workspace

tasks.design: Configure a method and prior-analysis index in {DOCS} and {DATA_PLATFORM}, then reuse its references in the actual strategy-note form in {PROJECT}. The scientist retains the consultation and writes the recommendation reasoning; only repeated lookup navigation and standard reference fields change.
tasks.previous_blocker: Relevant prior work and method constraints are scattered across projects.
tasks.enabler_now: Native metadata views and note templates can reuse existing method identifiers and constraints.
tasks.still_hard: Match an inferential question to feasible data and an appropriate computational strategy.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise that a researcher's stated technical request does not answer the scientific question.

ambition.what: Compare a proposed method with prior projects' data limitations before agreeing a strategy.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: method metadata and strategy-note templates can reduce repeated retrieval and reference copying without deciding scientific suitability.

assumptions: Boundary covers an actual researcher consultation and the project decision note used to guide subsequent analysis. No new consultation report is added. Researcher time is unchanged outside focal labour.

Researcher supplies question, assay type, data location and constraints; scientist captures decisions during s2/s3. Existing method owners supply method id, version, prerequisites and prior-project references. Missing metadata is manually checked in retained s1 time.

Test native indexes and templates first. S1 removes navigation but retains method reading; s3 removes only reference and standard-field copying while retaining reasoning and decision capture. Ordinary author saves are tiny, ungated and fully retained.
All shares are unmeasured focal labour estimates. Incremental upkeep covers method-index corrections beyond ordinary note writing.
unknowns: Existing method catalogue coverage and project-note practice.
research_questions: Which method requirements are reliably structured and already maintained?

already_counted.description: Method interpretation, consultation and substantive recommendation writing remain.

incremental.description: Correct method-index references after method updates.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central cuts 9 retrieval and 3.8 standard note fields give 12.8 gross and 12.05 net. Cautious case: a new assay has few indexed precedents, leaving s1 at 90% and bespoke reasoning leaves s3 at 95%; 2.95 gross less upkeep 0.75 gives 2.2, above low 2.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Provide validated statistical and computational tools

steps.what: Define statistical and computational tool requirements for the biological activity
Configure the statistical and computational tools with the required inputs and outputs
Validate the tools against known genetic or gene-expression datasets and document correct use
Review the final computational tools and validation record for release to researchers
Provide the approved computational tools by publishing the exact validated release to the research workspace

tasks.design: Reuse approved pipeline components and parameter forms in {DATA_PLATFORM} before writing new code. The scientist validates the assembled tool on known biological datasets, then the existing independent maintainer reviews the final release candidate before its separate publication.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeatedly wiring established tools and input/output parameters duplicates operator work.
tasks.enabler_now: Versioned pipeline components and reusable parameter schemas can remove that repeated assembly.
tasks.still_hard: Statistical assumptions, reference versions and correct biological interpretation of outputs.
tasks.human_edge: Reject a technically functioning tool whose assumptions do not fit the assay.

ambition.what: Provide a validated self-service configuration for one recurring gene-expression analysis.

reach.learn: Dependency pinning and biological acceptance tests.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: versioned pipeline components and parameter schemas can reduce repeated tool assembly; biological acceptance testing and release review remain necessary.

assumptions: Boundary is adapting established computational tools through an actual governed workspace release. The independent maintainer review is an existing team process, not new free work; confirm locally. This is not novel algorithm research or a clinical deployment.

Scientist captures use case, assay, organism, reference version, inputs and acceptance criteria in s1. Existing component maintainers supply parameter schema and dependency versions. Known test datasets and expected results are selected and checked in s3; missing schema fields are handled within retained s2/s3 time.

Native pipeline reuse is tested first. S2 removes repeated wiring and parameter boilerplate only, retaining assay-specific configuration. S3 retains tests, scientific checks, manual corrections and usage documentation. Existing compute runtime is excluded.
S4 reviews the exact candidate and validation evidence after they exist; any change voids approval. S5 is a small formal release with no saving, distinct from ordinary ungated author workspace saves.
Focal B86 excludes fourteen unchanged maintainer shares. Times are unmeasured task estimates; incremental upkeep funds configuration and failed-reuse recovery.
unknowns: Reusable approved components and existing release-review process.
research_questions: Which configurations pass the known biological acceptance cases without bespoke rewiring?

already_counted.description: Requirements, specific configuration, validation and release remain.
Existing independent maintainer release review remains unchanged.

incremental.description: Maintain reusable configurations and recover component incompatibilities.

approvals.approved_version: tool candidate, dependencies and validation snapshot reviewed in s4; changes void release

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central 18-share configuration cut over focal B86 gives 20.930 gross and 19.930 net. Cautious case: incompatible component schemas leave s2 at 85% retained, giving 4.5/86 = 5.232 gross and 4.232 net. Validation and independent review remain intact.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Analyze molecular datasets with reproducible preparation

steps.what: Define the clinical or basic research question and analysis constraints for molecular datasets
Prepare large molecular datasets and reconcile sample, assay and reference metadata
Analyze the molecular datasets through the selected versioned pipeline and collect its outputs
Check molecular dataset quality, batch effects and statistical assumptions against the analysis outputs
Interpret the molecular datasets findings for the stated research purpose
Save the molecular analysis interpretation and version references in the research workspace

tasks.design: Configure validated molecular-file import and manifest checks in {DATA_PLATFORM}, then reuse a versioned pipeline for repeated operator setup and output collection. The scientist retains dataset reconciliation, quality review and biological interpretation, saving only an internal research analysis in {DOCS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated file preparation and manual pipeline orchestration compete with analytical judgement.
tasks.enabler_now: Supported import schemas and versioned workflows can make recurring analyses reproducible.
tasks.still_hard: Batch effects, reference mismatch and valid inference from high-dimensional data.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise a clean-looking output that answers the wrong scientific question.

ambition.what: Compare sensitivity to a prespecified reference or filtering choice before interpreting a molecular result.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: versioned workflows and validated data manifests can reduce repeated molecular-data preparation and operator orchestration; quality and scientific inference remain human.

assumptions: Boundary is molecular analysis through an internal checked research interpretation. It includes clinical research datasets but no diagnostic report release or patient-management decision. Any such release follows its existing separate clinical authority workflow.

Laboratory or sequencing staff already produce raw files and sample id, assay, organism, reference, batch and run metadata. Scientist captures analysis choices in s1 and reconciles or manually supplies missing manifest fields in retained s2 time. No structured input is assumed without a producer.

Test native file import and pipeline configuration first. S2 removes repeated file alignment and metadata copying; s3 removes recurring operator commands, joins and output collection. Existing algorithm or queue runtime is not baseline human labour and earns no saving.

Failed imports and pipeline runs stop for manual repair within retained s2/s3/s4 time, with additional recovery upkeep. S4 keeps all scientific quality checks, s5 all interpretation, and s6 its tiny ungated author save.
All shares are unmeasured focal labour estimates. Source-laboratory work is unchanged outside the focal denominator; no additional free data-cleaning service is assumed.
unknowns: Actual assay compatibility and how much orchestration is already automated.
research_questions: Which recurring operator actions remain manual after native workflow reuse?

already_counted.description: Specification, missing metadata capture, exceptional runs, quality checks and interpretation remain.

incremental.description: Maintain manifest mappings and workflow versions and recover failed preparations.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central cuts 12 preparation and 15 operator setup give 27 gross and 25.5 net. Cautious case: legacy files leave s2 at 90% and bespoke analysis leaves s3 at 85%; gross 5.75 less upkeep 1.5 gives 4.25. Quality review and interpretation remain fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop and validate a novel computational method

steps.what: Create the conceptual computational approach and acceptance criteria required by research goals
Implement the novel computational approach as an analytical tool candidate

loop.purpose: Draft a bounded implementation of the scientist's specified algorithm
loop.input: Explicit method specification, dependency interface and acceptance cases
loop.output: Candidate code with assumptions and unresolved points
loop.check: Scientist inspects the algorithm, tests known cases and benchmarks against baselines in s3
loop.stop: One implementation draft per specified module; failed or ambiguous code returns for manual development
loop.why_not_simpler: Novel specified logic is not available as a configured component and requires code composition

steps.what: Validate the novel analytical tools against known cases, alternative methods and research goals
Review the final novel computational tool and validation evidence for a research release
Publish the exact approved novel analytical tool release for the research project

tasks.design: Keep novel method design with the scientist and test existing components first; when they cannot implement the approach, allow one bounded code draft in the development workspace in {OTHER}. Preserve scientific benchmarking in {DATA_PLATFORM} and the existing independent review before the separate research release.
tasks.previous_blocker: Implementing a precisely described method still requires repetitive code construction alongside conceptual research.
tasks.enabler_now: Code drafting can supply an inspectable implementation candidate, without establishing scientific validity.
tasks.still_hard: Prove the method answers the research question and behaves correctly beyond easy benchmarks.
tasks.human_edge: Invent a useful approach and detect a misleading improvement caused by a flawed comparison.

ambition.what: Provide a reproducible benchmark package with the newly developed research method.

reach.learn: Algorithm invariants and adversarial benchmark construction.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: bounded code drafting can reduce implementation effort for an explicit algorithm, but it does not establish novelty, correctness or biological validity.

assumptions: Boundary is novel method development through an internal governed research release, not clinical deployment. It assumes the team's existing independent software/scientific review; no new reviewer labour is silently added.

Scientist creates the actual specification and expected acceptance cases in s1. Existing dataset custodians provide benchmark datasets and provenance, but scientist selects and verifies their appropriateness in s3. Missing expected results require manual derivation within s1/s3, not invented labels.

Native components and deterministic reuse are tested first; the loop applies only where the specified novel logic cannot be configured. S2 removes first-version coding and boilerplate, retaining manual integration and repair. S3 retains algorithm inspection, benchmarks and counterexamples; compute runtime is excluded.

OTHER is the research development workspace and versioned code repository. Ordinary author workspace saves remain tiny and ungated inside s2; s5 is the distinct formal version release and is fully retained. Independent s4 review binds candidate, dependency versions and validation evidence; edits void approval.

Focal B91 excludes nine unchanged reviewer shares. All times are unmeasured estimates. Incremental allowance funds failed-code recovery and helper configuration beyond normal validation, not a second deduction of s3.
unknowns: How much implementation can be specified without unresolved methodological research.
research_questions: Does the draft preserve algorithm invariants on difficult benchmark cases?

already_counted.description: Conceptual work, manual code repair, scientific validation and release remain.
Existing independent research software review remains unchanged.

incremental.description: Recover unusable code drafts and maintain the bounded development configuration.

approvals.approved_version: candidate code, dependency and validation snapshot independently reviewed in s4; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central implementation cut 18 over focal B91 gives 19.780 gross and 18.780 net. Cautious case: the novel algorithm needs substantial manual reconstruction, leaving s2 at 85%; 4.5/91 gives 4.945 gross and 3.945 net, above low 3. Conceptual research and validation retain all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The scientist retains research strategy and validation while reducing repeated method lookup, data preparation and implementation mechanics.
reach: Research software engineer: package validated analytical workflows.
Research data steward: maintain assay and method requirements.
role.ambitious_version: Offer reproducible computational methods with explicit biological acceptance evidence and controlled research releases.
